newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VINNIE JONES RECALLED TO WELSH SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VINNIE JONES RECALLED TO WELSH SQUAD.

text.p: Manager Bobby Gould recalled Wimbledon hardman Vinnie Jones to the Wales squad for their World Cup group seven qualifying match against Holland in Eindhoven on November 9.

But Ian Rush, Wales' top international scorer with 28 goals in 73 appearances and still looking for his first goal of the season for Leeds, was overlooked again despite Chelsea's Mark Hughes being unavailable through suspension.
Arsenal striker John Hartson will be favourite to partner Dean Saunders in Hughes' absence.
Nathan Blake, Bolton's in-form striker, wins a call-up, along with defenders Gareth Hall (Sunderland) and Alan Neilson (Southampton), drafted in for injured Blackburn centre-half Chris Coleman.
Jones, who played under Gould at Wimbledon, won the last of his five caps in the 2-0 friendly defeat against Switzerland in Lugano in April.
Defenders: Gareth Hall (Sunderland), Andy Melville (Sunderland), Alan Neilson (Southampton), Mark Bowen (West Ham), Kit Symons (Manchester City), Mark Pembridge (Sheffield Wednesday)
Midfield: Barry Horne (Birmingham), John Robinson (Charlton), Gary Speed (Everton), Vinnie Jones (Wimbledon), Andy Legg (Birmingham),
Forwards: Ryan Giggs (Manchester United), Dean Saunders (Nottingham Forest), John Hartson (Arsenal), Nathan Blake (Bolton), Gareth Taylor (Sheffield United).
